# Code of Conduct

ULTRAMETRICA is an independent scientific and mathematical research repository maintained by **Alexander Stephen Donahue** (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; handle `0thernes`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`).

## Expected Conduct
- Critique ideas, derivations, proofs, and code rigorously — never people.
- Provide reproducible counterexamples, exact parameter tuples, or primary literature citations when challenging any theorem or claim.
- Respect attribution requirements and the non-commercial boundaries documented in [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE) and [`LEGAL.md`](../LEGAL.md).

## Enforcement
Harassment, bad-faith spam, or license-stripping plagiarism may be reported privately to `0_0@0thernes.art`.
